system.description:
You embrace the path of the Primal, forging a disciplined connection with the living world. Your practices echo the rhythms of element, plant and creature, allowing supernatural abilities to manifest as expressions of natural balance rather than as a separate reserve of power.

Your magical tradition is verdant, your magical ability score is Constitution, and you gain Nature as a class skill.

Magical Tradition: verdant. Magical Ability Score: Constitution. Nature is used for Recall Knowledge and other checks concerning the path's verdant magic.

Automated: Nature becomes a class skill. Innate spells your Mystic class and disciplines grant, and the magical techniques that name your Monastic Path, are cast as verdant with Constitution; a technique that uses your Technique Save DC uses 10 + Constitution + your level.
